complexity.notes: Reading the bits with integer operations (i >> j) & 1 avoids the string formatting overhead, though the asymptotics are unchanged. Space is dominated by the output; auxiliary space is O(n).
complexity.summary: Iterates over all 2^n bitmasks, formats each index as an n-bit binary string, and collects the elements whose bit is set. This is optimal up to constants since the output itself contains n * 2^(n-1) values.
